verdict.rationale: The SDK ships with the official Claude Code CLI bundled, so no separate install is needed. It runs by spawning and supervising a `claude` CLI subprocess. The CLI has a documented reference, `claude agents` and MCP-setup workflows, and a community user confirms building a headless automated workflow around `claude -p`. Missing for 10: the CLI reference contents are not detailed in the evidence, there is no SDK-specific CLI (e.g. scaffolding or project commands), and independent corroboration of AI-native CLI workflows is thin.
